newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt seen forced to limit early retirements.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt seen forced to limit early retirements.

text.p: The Italian government will "probably" be forced to impose a temporary block on early retirements in the public sector this year to prevent a deficit overshoot, the Treasury's public spending committee said on Thursday.

Rumours of a forthcoming pension reform has sent public sector workers rushing to claim their pensions, with unions saying a 100,000 workers have already filed for retirement in 1997 against 80,000 people in all of 1996.

Two representatives from the Treasury's technical committee for public spending (CTSP) told the lower house of parliament's budget commission that a block would almost certainly be needed to avoid a surge in spending on new pensions.
They said such a block could be contained in the forthcoming mini-budget, along with a reduction in loans to health services and an increase in contributions paid by hospital patients.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has indicated he will introduce a package of around 14 trillion lire of deficit-cutting measures before the end of April. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
